description_zh:
把 AI Passport 变成随身宝可梦冒险。听完大木博士的介绍，从御三家或皮卡丘中选择伙伴，在森林、山洞、海边和电站寻找前 151 只宝可梦。

宣传片（约 3 分 43 秒，含赤红片段）：
https://github.com/Luobata/ESP32-PokemonGo/blob/main/reports/video/pokewalk-story-red-2026-09-09/pokewalk-story-v3.mp4
这是 9 月 9 日录制的故事版，包含开局、捕获、养成与挑战；尚未包含森林秘境，按键与部分规则以当前版本为准。

掌握投球时机，收集不同伙伴与闪光形态，组建六人队伍。照料影响成长和探索收益，进化、图鉴与成就还能带来道具奖励。十二位地图训练家可重复切磋，低等级队员有经验追赶，随后挑战道馆、四天王、冠军与赤红。现在也能带上自己培养的伙伴，进入连续闯关的森林秘境。

战斗自动从已学招式中出招，技能随成长解锁，无需管理 PP 或遗忘技能。配有像素动画、场景音乐、音量与静音控制，支持自动熄屏。统一使用体能安排日常冒险，约 1 小时从零恢复满。

探索根据周边 Wi-Fi 环境变化判断移动，不是真实计步。当前支持 191 种招式，并非完整金银复刻。非官方同人项目，名称、画面与音乐的素材来源见源码说明。

每枚徽章解锁一项新探索活动。随机追踪会轮换目标，收集图鉴、闪光伙伴和进化道具；带上自己的伙伴挑战森林秘境，组合强化并逐段获得奖励，通关后还能发现一只可捕获伙伴。

菜单与照料页可显示电量；选项支持电量显示开关、亮度、音量、静音与 Wi-Fi 校时；校时后可补回关机期间的体能。网页与离线工具支持 USB 备份、确认导入，方便保存进度。同一设备可导入新版固件支持的旧存档；更新前请备份，跨版本导入需同时更新设备与存档工具。

存档管理：https://luobata.github.io/ESP32-PokemonGo/
完整历次更新：https://github.com/Luobata/ESP32-PokemonGo/tree/main/reports
description_en:
Turn AI Passport into a pocket Pokémon adventure. Meet Professor Oak, choose a starter or Pikachu, and explore four areas for the first 151 Pokémon. Catch shinies, raise a party of six and earn evolution items through achievements. Train against twelve route opponents, then challenge Gyms, the Elite Four, the Champion and Red, or take your own partners into the Forest dungeon.

Battles automatically choose from learned moves, with no PP or forgetting. Pixel animation, scene music, volume, mute and screen sleep are included. Movement is inferred from Wi-Fi changes, not step counting. There are 191 moves; this is not a complete Gold/Silver recreation. This unofficial fan project credits artwork, music and naming sources in the repository.

Story video (3m43s, including Red):
https://github.com/Luobata/ESP32-PokemonGo/blob/main/reports/video/pokewalk-story-red-2026-09-09/pokewalk-story-v3.mp4
Recorded September 9, before the Forest dungeon. Current controls and rules differ in places.

Each badge unlocks another exploration activity. Rotating tracking targets, shinies and evolution items give you more to collect. Take your own partners through the Forest dungeon, combine upgrades and earn rewards along the way, and discover a capturable partner after clearing the final boss.

Menu and Care can show the battery level. Options includes a battery-display toggle, brightness, volume, mute and Wi-Fi time sync for powered-off stamina recovery. Online and offline USB tools back up saves and import them after device confirmation. You can import older saves on the same device when supported by the installed firmware. Back up before updating, and update both the device and save tool for cross-version import.

Save manager: https://luobata.github.io/ESP32-PokemonGo/
Full update history: https://github.com/Luobata/ESP32-PokemonGo/tree/main/reports
instructions_zh:
开始冒险
首次开机听完大木博士介绍，按画面提示从妙蛙种子、小火龙、杰尼龟或皮卡丘中选择伙伴。已有存档会继续原进度。游戏可离线游玩，不需要先配网。

按键
A 上一项，B 下一项，C 确认；长按 B 返回，长按 C 熄屏。无操作约 60 秒自动熄屏，按任意功能键唤醒，唤醒的第一下不会触发页面操作。捕获时 A/B 切换球，C 在合适时机投球；部分页面操作以屏幕提示为准。

从哪里开始
主页用 A/B 选择照料、菜单或遭遇，再按 C。菜单可以进入图鉴、队伍、道具、照料、挑战、选项、成就、探索与秘境。建议先去「探索」选择路线寻找伙伴，获得遭遇后选择捕获或战斗。战斗自动从已学招式出招，无需管理 PP。玩耍需要至少 5 点体能；体能不足仍可用树果喂食。成长到进化条件后，设为队首并到「照料 → 进化」确认。

体能与挑战
体能上限 100，约 1 小时恢复满。普通探索与路线训练家切磋消耗 5 点；道馆、强化重赛和赤红消耗 10 点；四天王与冠军整轮消耗 20 点。森林秘境选择自己的 1～3 只伙伴，新开局消耗 20 点，继续旅程不重复收费；场间保留局内 HP 和异常，已结算奖励不会因失败或结束丢失。

电量显示
菜单和照料页的宝可梦名字右侧显示电量，20% 及以下变红。在「菜单 → 选项 → 电量显示」按 C 开关，重启后保留选择。

成就与秘境伙伴
背包道具已满仍可领取成就，奖励补到上限，超出部分不增加。森林秘境最终首领通关结算后，会把一只可捕获伙伴放入「遭遇」；返回遭遇列表选择它，再正常投球捕获。列表最多五只，满时替换最早一只。

声音与亮度
「菜单 → 选项」可切换静音、调整音量和亮度。音量或亮度按 C 进入调整，A 加、B 减，C 完成；亮度范围 10%–100%。设置重启后保留。调音量不会自动解除静音。

Wi-Fi 校时与关机体能
进入「菜单 → 选项 → Wi-Fi校时」，按 C 开启配网。手机连接设备画面显示的 PW- 开头临时热点，密码也显示在设备上；保持连接，即使手机提示此热点无法上网。浏览器打开 http://192.168.4.1，填写可用的 2.4GHz 家庭 Wi-Fi 或另一台设备提供的热点名称和密码，点击「连接并保存」。回到设备查看状态，显示「时间已同步」即成功。
配网热点约 5 分钟自动关闭；C 可关闭或重新开启，长按 B 返回也会关闭。连接失败检查名称、密码和网络，再重新开启配网；非配网画面按 A 重试联网校时。成功联网后保存网络，下次开机自动连接。首次校时建立时间基准，之后开机校时才能补回关机期间的体能；断网仍可游玩。

备份与导入
桌面 Chrome / Edge 打开 https://luobata.github.io/ESP32-PokemonGo/，选择私人备份目录，用 USB 数据线连接设备并授权串口，关闭占用串口的日志工具。设备进入「菜单 → 选项 → 备份存档」，按 C；等网页文件保存、设备提示完成。文件保存在自己的电脑，不上传。
导入时先在设备打开「选项 → 导入存档」，网页选择 .pksave 文件并请求导入。设备默认取消，需选择确认覆盖并按 C；系统先备份当前进度，再导入并重启，重新连接网页核对结果。导入要求同一设备，且当前固件支持备份的存档格式。本版可读取 V5～V17 旧存档，不再要求固件构建完全相同；不支持将较新的存档导入不认识该格式的旧固件。旧 .pksave 文件无需转换或修改。
离线使用可在网页下载工具 ZIP，解压后用 Python 3.8 或以上运行 python3 server.py（Windows 可用 py -3 server.py），再打开 http://localhost:8767/。跨版本导入请先更新设备固件，并刷新网页；离线用户请重新下载工具 ZIP。只有更新网页、设备仍用旧固件时，仍可能提示不兼容。开发命令行 restore.py 仍限同一构建，跨版本请用网页或离线网页工具。

牛奶回复
训练家、道馆与联盟对战的「战术 → 牛奶回复」现在回复最大 HP 的一半（向上取整），至少 50 HP，不超过满血，并解除异常状态。使用占一回合，倒下的伙伴不能使用；照料时仍是饱食 +20、心情 +10。

更新前请先备份。社区完整安装可能覆盖存档，请保留原备份文件；导入兼容以当前固件能读取的存档格式为准。
instructions_en:
Start your adventure
On first boot, follow Professor Oak's introduction and choose Bulbasaur, Charmander, Squirtle or Pikachu. An existing save resumes your progress. You can play offline without setting up Wi-Fi.

Controls
A moves up, B moves down and C confirms. Hold B to return; hold C to turn the screen off. It also sleeps after about 60 idle seconds. Any function button wakes it, consuming that first press. During capture, A/B change balls and C throws; follow each screen's prompts.

Your first steps
Select Care, Menu or Encounters on the home screen with A/B, then C. The menu includes Pokédex, Party, Items, Care, Challenges, Options, Achievements, Exploration and Dungeon. Start in Exploration, choose a route and find a partner, then choose capture or battle. Battles select learned moves automatically without PP management. Playing requires at least 5 stamina; you can still feed a berry when stamina is low. When a partner meets its evolution requirement, make it the leader and confirm in Care > Evolution.

Stamina and challenges
Stamina caps at 100 and recovers from empty in about one hour. Exploration and route-trainer matches cost 5, Gym/rematch/Red challenges cost 10, and an Elite Four plus Champion run costs 20 once. Choose 1–3 of your own partners for the Forest dungeon. A new run costs 20, continuing costs no extra entry fee. Dungeon HP and status persist between nodes; rewards already settled remain after defeat or retirement.

Battery display
Menu and Care show battery level beside your partner’s name; 20% or less is red. Toggle it with C in Menu > Options > Battery Display. Your choice survives restart.

Achievements and dungeon partners
Full item stacks no longer block achievement claims. Rewards fill only to their holding limit; excess is not added. Clearing and settling the final Forest dungeon boss adds one capturable partner to Encounters. Select it there and throw a ball normally. At the five-encounter limit, the oldest is replaced.

Sound and brightness
Options has mute, volume and brightness. Press C to edit volume or brightness, A to increase, B to decrease and C to finish. Brightness ranges from 10% to 100%. Preferences survive restart. Adjusting volume does not disable mute.

Wi-Fi Time and powered-off stamina
Open Menu > Options > Wi-Fi Time and press C to start setup. Connect your phone to the temporary PW- hotspot shown on the device, using its displayed password. Stay connected even if the phone says there is no internet. Open http://192.168.4.1 in the browser, enter a working 2.4 GHz home Wi-Fi network or another device's hotspot name and password, then submit. Check the game screen: “时间已同步” means time is synchronized.
The setup hotspot closes after about five minutes. C closes or reopens it; holding B returns and closes setup. If connection fails, check the network details and open setup again. Outside setup, A retries connection/time sync. A successful network is saved for later boots. The first time sync establishes a baseline; later startup syncs restore powered-off stamina. Offline play remains available.

Backup and import
Open https://luobata.github.io/ESP32-PokemonGo/ in desktop Chrome/Edge. Select a private folder, connect the device using a USB data cable and authorize its serial connection. Close other serial monitors. On the device, open Options > Backup and press C. Wait until the website saves the file and the device confirms completion. Saves stay on your computer.
For import, first open Options > Import on the device, select a .pksave file on the website and request import. Cancel is selected by default on the device; choose confirmation and press C to proceed. Current progress is backed up before importing, then the device restarts. Reconnect to verify the result. Import requires the same device and a save format supported by the installed firmware. This release reads older V5–V17 saves without requiring an identical firmware build. Newer unsupported saves cannot be imported into older firmware. Keep your original .pksave file; no conversion or editing is needed.
For offline use, download and extract the tool ZIP from the site. With Python 3.8 or later, run python3 server.py (or py -3 server.py on Windows) and open http://localhost:8767/. For cross-version import, update the device firmware and refresh the website, or download the offline ZIP again. Updating only the website cannot remove an old firmware restriction. The developer restore.py command still requires an identical build; use the online or offline web tool for cross-version import.

Milk recovery
In trainer, Gym and League battles, Tactics > Milk Recovery restores half of maximum HP, rounded up, with a minimum of 50 HP and capped at full health. It also clears status conditions and costs one turn. Fainted partners cannot use it. Its Care effect remains +20 fullness and +10 mood.

Back up before updating. A full community installation may overwrite saves. Keep your original backup; import compatibility depends on the save formats supported by the installed firmware.
changelog_zh:
10 月 4 日修复：旧备份导入与牛奶回复

1. 修复更新游戏后，旧备份因固件构建不同而无法导入的问题。同一设备现可导入当前固件支持的旧存档（本版 V5～V17）；原 .pksave 文件无需转换或修改。

2. 导入前先检查实际存档内容与版本，通过后才覆盖；保留设备确认、覆盖前自动备份、传输校验与断电恢复。其他设备、损坏文件及不支持的新格式仍会拒绝导入，保护当前进度。

3. 网页与离线网页存档工具同步修复跨版本导入限制。请同时更新设备固件，并刷新在线网页或重新下载离线工具 ZIP；只更新一侧可能仍提示不兼容。开发命令行恢复仍限同一构建。

4. 哞哞牛奶的对战回复从固定 50 HP 改为最大 HP 的一半（向上取整），至少 50 HP，不超过满血。例如最大 HP 300 回复 150，最大 HP 500 回复 250。继续解除异常状态，战斗内使用占一回合；倒下或满血且无异常时不会消耗，保存失败也不会扣除。照料效果不变。

更新前请先备份；社区完整安装可能覆盖进度。跨版本兼容不包括将较新的存档导入不认识该格式的旧固件。
存档管理：https://luobata.github.io/ESP32-PokemonGo/
changelog_en:
October 4 fixes: Older save imports and Milk recovery

1. Fixed older backups being rejected after a game update solely because the firmware build changed. The same device can now import older save formats supported by the installed firmware (V5–V17 in this release). Original .pksave files need no conversion or editing.

2. The device checks the actual save content and version before replacing progress. Device confirmation, a backup of current progress, transfer integrity checks and power-interruption recovery remain in place. Other devices, damaged files and unsupported newer formats are still rejected.

3. Updated the online and offline web save tools to allow cross-version import. Update the device firmware and refresh the website, or download the offline ZIP again. Updating only one side may still show an incompatibility message. The developer command-line restore still requires the same build.

4. Moomoo Milk now restores half of maximum HP, rounded up, with a minimum of 50 HP and capped at full health, instead of a fixed 50. A partner with 300 maximum HP recovers 150; one with 500 recovers 250. It still clears status conditions and costs a turn in battle. Fainted partners, fully healthy partners without a status condition, and failed saves do not consume Milk. Its Care effect is unchanged.

Back up before updating; a full community installation may overwrite progress. Cross-version support does not allow newer saves to load on older firmware that cannot read their format.
Save manager: https://luobata.github.io/ESP32-PokemonGo/
